specification.input: H*x<=bH and g(S*x-bS), g(r)=max(L,maxr) on maxr<=U, infinity otherwise. Source538/539 copied-original rows and517 proof inherited by hash. Native costs must be zero, native bounds unbounded, equalities literally zero/RHS zero; reject unsupported nonzero domain, never silently drop it. specification.metric: For K=vertical_stack(H,S), compute EXACT positive absolute row/column sums using integer units2^-1074. For each positive sum choose least enclosing power2^p, then sigma_i=2^(-p_i-1),tau_j=2^(-p_j-1); zero sum uses1. Reject nonfinite/zero step. Fixed once per NEW input; no adaptive balance/tuning. All source coefficients stay unchanged.
specification.norm_proof: Exact sigma_i*rowL1_i<=1/2 and tau_j*colL1_j<=1/2. Cauchy gives ||sqrt(Sigma)*K*sqrt(T)*z||^2 <= sum_i sigma_i*rowL1_i*sum_j|Kij|*tau_j*z_j^2 <=1/4*||z||^2. Thus norm<=1/2<1. This proves a valid exact-real metric condition, NOT a finite-arithmetic convergence rate or45s success.
specification.initialization: x=xbar=0,yH=lambda=0. Native increment zero is an LP seed, not physical hard feasibility. No warm start. Fixed theta1,no restart,acceleration,line search,ergodic averaging or best-iterate selection.
specification.iteration: wH=yH+sigmaH*(H*xbar); yHnew=max(wH-sigmaH*bH,0). wS=lambda+sigmaS*(S*xbar); lambdanew=weighted prox of bS.lambda+g* at wS. xnew=x-T*(H.T*yHnew+S.T*lambdanew); xbarnew=2*xnew-x. All native coordinates remain joint. Cone projections concern dual variables only, no primal clipping/normalization.
specification.finite_prox: q=w-sigma*(b+L), width=U-L. Select a=0, width, or sorted weighted-simplex threshold from q/sigma and longdouble prefix sums, then lambda=max(q-sigma*a,0). No bisection/retry. Check finite/nonnegative output, threshold bounds, scaled orthant stationarity and hinge complementarity<=1e-12. These numerical algebra screens are NOT an exact rational proximal certificate nor a summable-error convergence theorem. Independent small audit computes exact proximal primal-dual gaps of SAVED evaluations.
specification.finite_limits: Exact-real convergence assumes an existing saddle point and exact arithmetic/proximals. Fixed finite screens and IEEE arithmetic do not establish that hypothesis or global convergence. Only explicit original unscaled numerical KKT may return a candidate. No empirical speed/conditioning/global infeasibility claim.
specification.scalar: At every numerical screen v=max(L,max(S*x-bS)), without clipping to U; t=e*v. If KKT screens pass, compute every coupled residual with exactFraction source coefficients and binary64 x, take exact v=max(L,maxr), round ONCE nearest binary64 and t=e*v. Record exact maximum/owning row/rounding error and lower slack. Native x is BITWISE unchanged. A rounded scalar can lie below exact max; do NOT call it exact feasible. Recheck all source numerical KKT/bounds at unchanged thresholds; no nextafter or repair.
specification.dual: s=sum(lambda); alpha=max(s-1,0),beta=max(1-s,0). Swap bound multipliers if e=-1. Source row duals are yH/lambda; numerical native stationarity and original scalar stationarity, source inequalities/bounds and absolute primal-dual gap all<=1e-9. Nonnegative finite duals required. Also source full inequalities<=1e-7. These are numerical KKT, not exact optimality.
specification.stopping: First nonfinite,proximal check failure,unsupported domain,cap or deadline ends with NO candidate. No internal vector selected on failure. No infeasibility/unboundedness certificate. After one eligible scalar reconstruction, any final KKT failure terminates rather than polishing.
